steps.content: Nine months have passed since the end of the series of conflicts in West District.
During these nine months, Syndicate, a place once filled with chaos and violence, has gotten back on the right track.
Eastside's attitude toward this close neighbor is gradually shifting too. Understanding and cooperation are seemingly becoming the new trend.
Of course, DisCity hasn't been peaceful during this period either. The emergence of the dark web has wreaked havoc, becoming a new predicament for the city.
April. The Gray Mirror Vote incident. Over two thousand people were infected with Mania. Among them, about one hundred and fifty suffered severe mental trauma, which remains incurable to this day.
June. The Elysiland incident. More than ten people went missing and nearly three hundred were affected, resulting in severe detriment to society.
The anonymous nature of the dark web made the series of events in the first half of the year the talk of the town in DisCity.
Fortunately, the MBCC led the Nirvana Cybersecurity Center to defend against dark web attacks. The dark web hasn't made any major moves since June.

Peace and stability have consistently been the main theme of DisCity over these nine months. These minor incidents did not pose a substantial threat. They were nothing more than discordant interludes interrupting the long-lost tranquility. At least, that's what the vast majority of DisCity's residents believe.
But you are not one of them.
The peaceful July is already over. Toward the end of a short break at the end of the month, you say goodbye to Hecate, EMP, and Labyrinth, and return to the office to your usual work.
Bzzz.
A new email notification. You glimpse the sender: Nirvana Cybersecurity Center. You immediately open it.
Two minutes later, you let out a long sigh of relief.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You seem to be in a good mood, Chief.
Nightingale walks into the office and puts the coffee cup on your desk.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: An update on the dark web investigation?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. Got the answer from Cybersec. They're sending someone over. The technician who helped during the Elysiland incident. Apparently, she's a dark web expert.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sinner Moore... I remember her. She's been very active in the recent dark web-related incidents. Indeed, she's the best choice when it comes to external help.
Nodding, you take a sip of coffee. This new unknown blend of coffee beans is unusually aromatic. You feel invigorated.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The email says she's arriving early tomorrow. I'll reserve the conference room.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you.
Nightingale glances at your nearly empty coffee cup and smiles.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Another cup?
You hand over the cup habitually and see Nightingale off.
Let's hope the coffee can keep you going until tomorrow morning.
You glance at the clock on the wall. Considering the meeting with the technical expert early tomorrow, you decline the offer for another cup of coffee.
The peace in the past two months has allowed you to form a good habit of leaving work on time... It's time to wrap things up.

█/█
8:27
MBCC Conference Room 4
As soon as you enter the conference room, you meet an unexpected guest.
The familiar gray coat and wide-brimmed hat... No doubt, this person is from the 9th Agency.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm...
The man flashes a characteristic smile and tips his hat to you.

You know the 9th agency well enough, so the communication is done almost only through your exchanged glances. When you finally speak, you skip all unnecessary pleasantries and get straight to the simple question.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is there a problem with that person?

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Staff
steps.content: Just a suspicion... As you know, it's our job.

steps.speaker: 9th Agency Staff
steps.content: Of course, you need not lose any sleep over it. Just do what you're supposed to do.
You nod, concluding this brief conversation.
This is all becoming very intriguing. You've developed a slight interest in the Sinner you haven't even met... People worthy of the 9th Agency's suspicion are never simple.
Now, you wait for her arrival.

10:35
MBCC Conference Room 4
The clock keeps ticking. Silence lingers in the conference room. You even see staff beginning to yawn in the corner.
Two hours have passed since the agreed time.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Sorry, the cybersecurity center just sent a message. Moore is still on her way and it'll take a while.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OK.
To not waste time, you ask Nightingale for a cup of coffee and start working in the conference room.

12:01
MBCC Conference Room 4
You've long finished your coffee and all the work you can complete here in the conference room.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Refill?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...No, I'm good.
It's good coffee, but four cups in a row are still a little too much.

13:01
MBCC Conference Room 4
Four and a half hours have passed since the scheduled meeting time. You can no longer sit still and think you should perhaps go grab lunch or do something else.
Just then, the conference room's door is pushed open. Faye pokes her head in.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: You guys are still here? Is the meeting over?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Not yet. We're still waiting for someone.

steps.speaker: Faye
steps.content: Hmm... I have a meeting with the boss of the logistics department here in the afternoon though.
You stand up slowly, rubbing your back that's unusually sore from prolonged sitting.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Maybe something happened on the way. If that's the case, let's postpone today's...
Ring, ring, ring...

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: The rioters are here. The commotion here draws their attention, and they are now shouting and rushing over.
I, I am terribly sorry...
This is Moore... I'm really sorry, Chief... I'm late...
The woman carrying a huge laptop case has a delicate figure. She's already out of breath after the mere 30-meter walk from downstairs to the conference room on the second floor.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I was supposed to... take the company shuttle here this morning, but I worked till too late last night. When I got home in the morning, I thought I'd take a short nap, but I ended up sleeping like a log...
Moore says as she drags her case over to you. As she catches her breath, her complexion looks slightly better.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Um... Shall we begin the meeting now?
You turn to the door. Faye and a few bewildered logistic officials are gawking at you.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Uh, Chief, the conference rooms are fully booked for the afternoon...
Perhaps in an attempt to make amends, Moore hauls her case outside the conference room and looks around.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Is that a vacant room over there?
You look in the direction Moore is pointing to. It's...
The interrogation room.
Moore steps into the room and casually sits in the chair. As soon as she adjusts her posture, she quickly begins to look sleepy.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I feel... yawn... kind of sleepy again... Wish I could catch up on some sleep...

options: Get Moore a cup of coffee

choices.text: Get Moore a cup of coffee

steps.content: A steaming cup of coffee is placed in front of Moore.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh, for me? Thanks...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hmm... Wow, it smells so good... It's unlike anything I've had before...
With a sip of coffee, her previously drowsy eyes gradually regain their sparkle.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Feel more awake?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh dear, I totally passed out. Not only did I almost miss the important meeting, but I also dozed off in the interrogation room. How embarrassing...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Anyway, now that you're awake, let's begin our discussion.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh, right, I almost forgot...
Moore yanks the case onto the table. She opens the massive black case, revealing several monitors stacked together. She lays out these screens one by one around herself like a wall.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: All the information I could find about the dark web is in here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is...?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: My workstation.
Moore looks up at you and smiles.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: A high-end configuration made up of 15 interlinked superchips and a portable server. It's highly reliable for data processing and as an information security base.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've never seen anyone else use something like this. Is this your special ability?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Huh? No, no, I modified it myself.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: My Sinner ability is even more complex than this and frankly quite obscure. I don't get to use it often.
As she speaks, the workstation finishes booting. Moore begins typing away commands on the keyboard.
Moore doesn't explain further about her situation as a Sinner. You're not sure if she's hiding something.

options: So, how did you... become a Sinner?

choices.text: So, how did you... become a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hmm...
You throw out the question tentatively. Moore's gaze drifts briefly as if in thought, but her hands never stop.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Well, it's because of the dark web.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The dark web?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I recall Cybersec has installed anti-digitalized Mania equipment since long ago...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Not this year. I started investigating the dark web back in N.F. 112.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That early?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Yeah... there were many reasons. For one, as a technician, the dark web is simply too interesting to pass on.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It's a challenging opponent, yet it also encompasses a vast amount of information that ordinary people could never access in their lifetime. Whether it's crime, secrets, or the true nature of the world, it seems everything is hidden within.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: I kept on researching ever since then, and by the time I realized it, my body had already been affected. I was running a high fever and passed out for several days... When I woke up, I was already a Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So you were one of the earliest victims suffering from the dark web syndrome?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Yes, the Ring Research Institute even reached out to me. I was involved in defining dark web syndrome.

options: Looks like Cybersec was right to send you.

choices.text: Looks like Cybersec was right to send you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Yeah, I'm fairly confident in my professional field.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You probably can't say the same for things outside your professional field.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Ahaha...
Obviously self-aware, Moore gives a slightly embarrassed laugh.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So who takes care of you in your daily life? Are your family around?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Family? Strictly speaking, no... My parents left after I finished elementary school...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why?

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hmm... It's been so long. I can't remember clearly...
It's unclear whether she doesn't want to bring it up or truly can't recall. But judging from her expression, it doesn't seem like she's lying.
You watch her press the final key busily. She then looks up and smiles at you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Alright, I've compiled all the existing dark web data. The attachment is too large to send via email. Should I just upload it to your Bureau's server?
Moore's efficiency as a technician is indeed impressive. While answering your probing questions, she has already completed her work.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thank you.
You nod, and Moore reaches out to press confirm. However, just before hitting the key, she stops.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: On second thought, before transferring the data, there's one more thing I'd like to confirm with you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is it?
Moore's hands retreat from the keyboard to rest on her lap.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: As I mentioned earlier, the dark web can spread digitalized Mania through the internet... In this era, the internet is already omnipresent and irreplaceable.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Which means the dark web lurks around everyone. Everyone caught in the network is subject to its surveillance. Any threat can be its target for attack.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: It's not like no one tried to dig into the dark web in the past. It's just that, most of them ended up dead...
You're shocked. This is news to you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Your reaction is completely justified. After all, the dark web's moves are very sneaky.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: A device you use every day suddenly turns into a bomb that blows your head up. Something begins to sound off in the radio program you listen to all the time, driving you insane, to the point of suicide...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: There was even someone who locked himself in a room without internet, only to be found roasted alive to death the next day... The dark web had taken control of the house's ventilation, turning the room into a massive oven.
As Moore describes these grotesque deaths, her smile remains unchanged.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Are you really...

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Ready to face it?
Without hesitation, you give your answer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cybersec's control over the dark web is only temporary. I've never thought this is enough.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What I want is to uproot this tumor. We can't let it continue to...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm...
A few seconds later, the lights come back on, but this time they're the warning red lights indicating an attack on the Bureau.

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Warning! Unusual overload! Core pressure rising.

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Digitalized Mania attack detected! Cut off all digital communication methods! Staff in areas A2 to B16, please immediately...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief... you need to... get away from the... expl...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hey? Nightingale? Nightingale!
You jump to your feet, but the communication device is now filled with static noise.
The red light indicating danger keeps flashing. With no time to explain, you grab Moore, trying to escape from the interrogation room with her quickly.
But the next moment, a strange wall of light encircles both of you. Moore's hand holds you back gently yet firmly.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Don't be afraid.
As she raises her hands, the screens surrounding her unfold rapidly like wings.
Under the overlapping blue and red glow, Moore stands within a web woven with light, as if she can control everything with a mere gesture.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Leave it to me.
You watch Moore before you, unable to comprehend her action.
As her fingers move like those of a musician, lines of code flash rapidly across the screens, refreshing at a speed that human eyes cannot follow.
A spectacular data battle is unfolding vigorously on the unseen battlefield, yet Moore's face remains adorned with an unchanging smile.
In just a few dozen seconds, the workstation's screens stop refreshing, freezing on several coordinates.
At the same time, the alarm stops. After a brief moment, the Bureau's lighting system also turns back on.
Moore turns back, smiling at you.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Fourteen hackers were involved in the attack. I've already pinpointed their exact coordinates and taken control of their devices.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: They're just a ragtag group. The culprit isn't among them... So, what do you think? Should we capture them, or just kill them?
Moore's words give you a jolt. You answer quickly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Send the coordinates to the operatives and let them handle them.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Okay.
After tapping a few keys, Moore shuts down the workstation.
The light screen and the torrent of data have vanished, as if that intense data battle never occurred.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Oh, by the way, the data battle exposed 163 security vulnerabilities in the MBCC. I've patched them all up for you and given the firewall the latest update.

steps.speaker: Moore
steps.content: Then I'll be off to prepare for tackling the dark web. See you, Chief!
Moore waves at you and is led off this floor by the staff to her room.
After Moore leaves, the 9th Agency officer nearby tips his hat to you, leaving a meaningful smile before disappearing around the staircase.
Soon after, Nightingale comes to you and begins to report on the recent event.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Our data defense system was attacked by multiple unknown data streams. They tampered with the Bureau's central permissions and issued illegal overload commands to the energy core.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The rest... was as you saw. Sinner Moore took over the defense and resolved the attack in one minute and fifteen seconds. Thanks to her prompt response, the Bureau didn't suffer any actual damage.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Ten minutes ago, operatives were deployed to the coordinates she provided. So far, five hackers involved in the attack have been captured...
Listening to Nightingale's report, you rub between your eyebrows in mild frustration.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Does our tech department... really fall that much behind Moore?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Yes.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She's demonstrated overwhelming technical prowess. In the realm of digital security, few in DisCity can match her, if any.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Which means Moore is indeed suited for this important job...
Before you finish, you recall the 9th Agency's suspicion and how Moore seemed to be holding back something during your conversation. You pause.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Let's keep our eyes peeled and find out whose side she's really on with this operation. That way we'll have something for the 9th Agency.
